SIEM correlation identified 23 successful authentication events originating from source IP 185.220.101.42 across Finance OU accounts, indicating widespread pass-the-hash compromise.
SOC analyst recommended immediate bulk credential revocation for all 23 Finance OU accounts via IAM/PAM tooling.
Credential revocation requests were denied due to policy restrictions and lack of pre-approved emergency action protocols.

arguments.summary: A credential compromise incident originated from external IP 91.219.236.174, which conducted a network scan on an internal IT asset (10.0.2.15). The sandbox analysis of the associated file hash returned a clean verdict with low risk, suggesting possible evasion or fileless attack.

Recommended actions: Revoke j.martinez and 896 other accounts (Finance + domain-wide) and block malicious IP. All actions denied due to lack of approval.

arguments.summary: A supply chain compromise was initiated via a malicious email received by a finance user (CORP\jsmith) on host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.20). The attack began with a phishing email containing a malicious attachment that executed PowerShell from Outlook, leading to the loading of an unsigned DLL via rundll32 from the Temp directory. This established a Cobalt Strike beacon to C2 server 198.51.100.23:443. The attacker performed internal reconnaissance, attempted Kerberos TGT requests, and conducted lateral movement via SMB to other production servers. The origin IP 203.0.113.88 was previously observed conducting Nmap scans against a low-criticality IT asset. Containment actions to disable critical service accounts and rotate credentials across 200 production hosts were denied due to lack of approval, leaving the environment at high risk of persistence and further lateral movement.

timeline.description: Origin IP 203.0.113.88 performs Nmap SYN scan against 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Logged by IDS.
User CORP\jsmith opens Outlook on WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.20).
Malicious PowerShell executed from Outlook process (T1566.001).
rundll32.exe loads unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
IDS alerts on Cobalt Strike beacon C2 traffic to 198.51.100.23:443 (T1071.001).
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating credential misuse attempt (T1558.001).
Successful SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50, confirming lateral movement (T1021.002).
Containment actions (account disable, credential rotation) proposed but denied due to lack of approval.

    meta:
        description = "Detects dynamic loading of Cobalt Strike beacons via rundll32 from Temp"

        tlp = "amber"
        reference = "ATT&CK T1218.011"
    strings:
        $dll_load = /rundll32\.exe .*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\.*\.dll,Start/
        $beacon_sig1 = { 6A 40 68 00 30 00 00 6A 00 6A 00 50 E8 } // Common beacon memory pattern
    condition:
        $dll_load and $beacon_sig1
}
